s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of skin and muscle symptoms following immunotherapy
salient_findings: Prominent erythema at nailfolds with dilated capillary loops
key_facts: Patient is a woman in her 50s
Diagnosed with stage IV B-RAF V600E mutant malignant melanoma
Metastases in liver, lungs, and peritoneum
Received ipilimumab treatment
Developed skin symptoms within 2 weeks of starting ipilimumab
Experienced initial improvement and later disease recurrence
Received a second course of ipilimumab 14 months later
Symptoms recurred and worsened after second course of ipilimumab
Physical findings include photodistributed erythematous to violaceous eruption
Elevated creatine kinase levels (1088 U/L and 1854 U/L)
Aldolase level: 23.0 U/L
C-reactive protein level: 28.6 mg/L
Antinuclear antibody titer: 1:640 with speckled pattern
Jo-1 antibody: negative
MRI showed mild short TI inversion recovery hyperintensity of bilateral vastus lateralis and rectus femoris muscles
Vastus lateralis muscle biopsy showed atrophy of type II muscle fibers

shortlist.label: dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: elevated creatine kinase levels and skin symptoms following immunotherapy

shortlist.label: polymyositis
shortlist.why_kept: elevated creatine kinase levels and muscle biopsy showing atrophy of type II muscle fibers

shortlist.label: myositis
shortlist.why_kept: elevated creatine kinase levels and muscle symptoms following immunotherapy

shortlist.label: melanoma
shortlist.why_kept: patient's known diagnosis of stage IV B-RAF V600E mutant malignant melanoma

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms, including photodistributed erythematous to violaceous eruption, elevated creatine kinase levels, and atrophy of type II muscle fibers, are consistent with dermatomyositis, which is also supported by the presence of antinuclear antibody titer with a speckled pattern.

rejected.label: polymyositis
rejected.why: The patient's skin symptoms and biopsy results showing atrophy of type II muscle fibers without evidence of inflammatory myositis are more consistent with dermatomyositis than polymyositis.

rejected.label: myositis
rejected.why: Myositis is a broad term that encompasses several conditions, including dermatomyositis and polymyositis; the patient's symptoms are more specific to dermatomyositis.

rejected.label: fixed drug eruption
rejected.why: While the patient developed skin symptoms after ipilimumab treatment, the symptoms and laboratory findings are more consistent with an autoimmune condition like dermatomyositis than a fixed drug eruption.

rejected.label: melanoma
rejected.why: The patient's primary diagnosis is melanoma, but the symptoms and laboratory findings described are related to a separate condition, dermatomyositis, which is likely a paraneoplastic syndrome associated with the melanoma.
